tasks.label: Setup: everything
tasks.detail: Start here. Fetches the DSP submodules, installs dependencies (repairing wrong-architecture native binaries), and configures both CMake projects. Idempotent - safe to re-run any time something looks broken

tasks.label: Setup: everything (web only, no C++)
tasks.detail: Same, minus the submodules and CMake - for working on the web app without a C++ toolchain

tasks.label: Install dependencies
tasks.detail: pnpm install across the workspace (apps/web, packages/ui). Prefer "Setup: everything" - it also repairs the wrong-architecture native binaries a pnpm running under emulation installs

tasks.label: Install Playwright browsers
tasks.detail: One-time fetch of the chromium/firefox/webkit binaries used by the e2e suite

tasks.label: Web: Dev server
tasks.detail: Starts the Vite dev server (apps/web) - web app only, no C++ toolchain needed

tasks.label: Build
tasks.detail: Typecheck + production build of the web app and packages/ui (excludes the native desktop app), via Turborepo

tasks.label: Lint
tasks.detail: oxlint, via Turborepo

tasks.label: Format check
tasks.detail: Prettier --check, via Turborepo

tasks.label: Format write
tasks.detail: Prettier --write

tasks.label: Test (watch)
tasks.detail: Vitest in watch mode (apps/web)

tasks.label: Test (run once)
tasks.detail: Vitest, single run - unit/component tests, via Turborepo

tasks.label: Test coverage
tasks.detail: Vitest with the v8 coverage report (apps/web)

tasks.label: E2E test
tasks.detail: Playwright e2e suite, via Turborepo - needs "Install Playwright browsers" run once first

tasks.label: Storybook
tasks.detail: Starts the Storybook dev server (packages/ui)

tasks.label: Full check (lint + format + build + test + e2e)
tasks.detail: Everything CI runs, in order - see .github/workflows/ci.yml

tasks.label: C++: Init submodules
tasks.detail: One-time fetch of the vendored DSP library submodules (dspark's Effects, NAMCore's Eigen/AudioDSPTools, Dragonfly's dpf) - needed before configuring packages/core. Skips whatever is already present

tasks.label: C++: Configure
tasks.detail: Configures the packages/core C++ DSP library with tests enabled - see packages/core/README.md if cmake isn't on your PATH

tasks.label: C++: Build
tasks.detail: Builds packages/core (graph engine, NAM wrapper, Dragonfly Reverb algorithms)

tasks.label: C++: Test
tasks.detail: Runs the packages/core CTest suite (graph engine, NAM inference, all 4 Dragonfly Reverb algorithms)

tasks.label: Setup & run everything (web + C++)
tasks.detail: One-shot local setup: pnpm install, init/configure/build/test the C++ engine, then start the web dev server

tasks.label: Desktop: Configure (with tests)
tasks.detail: Configures the apps/desktop C++ shell (webview + RtAudio + core) with the CTest suite enabled

tasks.label: Desktop: Build
tasks.detail: Release build of the native desktop app + bundles the React UI into build/ui (scripts/build.mjs)

tasks.label: Desktop: Dev (Debug build + launch)
tasks.detail: Debug-builds the desktop app and launches the window against the bundled web UI

tasks.label: Desktop: Dev (fast - skip the UI rebuild)
tasks.detail: Debug-builds and launches the desktop app reusing the UI already in build/ui - for C++-only changes

tasks.label: Desktop: Dev (attach to the web dev server)
tasks.detail: Debug-builds and launches the desktop app pointed at http://localhost:5173 (OPENAXE_UI_URL) - needs "Web: Dev server" running, gives the native shell Vite HMR

tasks.label: Dev: web + desktop (parallel)
tasks.detail: Runs the Vite dev server and the native desktop app side by side, each in its own terminal - two independent apps, one command

tasks.label: Build: web + desktop
tasks.detail: Production build of everything: web app, packages/ui, and the native desktop app (needs CMake + a C++20 compiler)

tasks.label: Desktop: C++ tests
tasks.detail: Runs the desktop CTest suite (audio I/O, JS bridge, latency) - needs Configure (with tests) + Build first

tasks.label: Desktop: Package
tasks.detail: Builds the app + UI and runs CPack -> build/openaxe-desktop-<v>.dmg|.zip|.deb

tasks.label: Desktop: Full check (build + C++ tests + web tests)
tasks.detail: Desktop C++ tests + the web suite the UI reuse depends on
